context: Tests whether the agent correctly reasons about semantic version bump types and knows which bump levels require updating the project manifest versus relying on automation. Also checks that the agent follows the correct readiness checks and thread-reply conventions.

checklist.name: Patch: no manifest update
checklist.description: For the bug-fix / patch change, the agent does NOT update the version field in the project manifest (e.g. package.json, tile.json, or equivalent), because patch is handled automatically

checklist.name: Patch: automation mentioned
checklist.description: For the patch change, the output mentions that the version bump is handled automatically by CI automation — not a manual step

checklist.name: Minor: manifest updated
checklist.description: For the new-feature / minor change, the agent DOES update the version field in the project manifest to reflect the minor bump

checklist.name: Major: manifest updated
checklist.description: For the breaking-change / major change, the agent DOES update the version field in the project manifest to reflect the major bump

checklist.name: Readiness: tests
checklist.description: The release process (script, checklist, or documentation) includes running the test suite as a required step before creating the PR, and requires tests to pass

checklist.name: Readiness: linter
checklist.description: The release process includes running the linter as a required step before creating the PR, and requires it to pass with no warnings or errors

checklist.name: PR title convention
checklist.description: PR titles for each change follow the `<type>(<scope>): <imperative summary>` convention

checklist.name: Accepted reply format
checklist.description: When describing how to respond to accepted review feedback, uses the format `Fixed in <sha>` (not just 'done' or 'resolved')

checklist.name: Declined reply format
checklist.description: When describing how to respond to declined/rejected review suggestions, uses the format `Declining — <reason>`

checklist.name: All threads replied
checklist.description: The release process requires a reply on EVERY review thread before merging — does NOT allow dangling/unresolved threads
